visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: All-Negative Input Returns Zero
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For -4 -1 -8 the best subarray is just -1, but the program prints 0.

solution.explanation: Starting best at 0 means the empty subarray is treated as a candidate, and nothing negative can beat it. A subarray must contain at least one element, so best starts from the first element.
